about: Java mutation plan: one entry per shard (the shard number is the 1-based position). Built from the PIT histories of full run 42472119807 (mutants per class and method, covering tests per mutant) and the measured per-mutant time of full run 42838755118 with one JVM per mutant (est_min assumes no savings from cheaper JVMs, 30% over the measured rate, a pessimistic rate for the shards that did not finish): every slice <= 190 min except single methods that cannot be split further. exclude_methods are exact method names of the same class; the last shard (rest) takes every class that is not listed, so a new class is mutated too. v2: shards 72, 19, 17, 41, 23, 31 and 22 were cancelled at the job limit in 42902111378 (their per-test cost was far above the model): each is split into parts of about 45 model minutes, the first part keeps the shard number and the others are appended after the rest shard. v3: Pq$Suite (7 mutants) is deliberately left to the catch-all rest shard, so that shard is never empty (the shared shard report refuses an empty shard). v4: shard 99 (GoalSemantics, 906 mutants) was cancelled at 355 min in 42956714806 at a measured 29.5 s/mutant (shard 98: 715 mutants took 351 min): split into 4 parts of ~227 mutants (~110 min at that rate).
